## Name Etymology

- **AEGIS** (αἰγίς) — divine shield of Zeus and Athena → absolute protection
- **AEGIR** (Ægir) — Norse god of the sea → mastery of flows
- **AEON** (αἰών) — eternity → "Engineered to Last"

Synthesis: "Aegryn protects what endures."

## Four Core Activities

### 1. Asset Engineering — Build
Aegryn designs, funds and operates its own portfolio of digital assets AND builds custom digital assets for third parties.

**Proprietary portfolio** (full IP, sovereign infrastructure, "An Aegryn company"):
- Subblink (https://subblink.app) — B2B SaaS, AI-powered contract analysis, risk detection, obligation mapping
- Neediu (https://neediu.com) — B2C marketplace, home services (cleaning, plumbing, childcare)
- Primiom (https://primiom.com) — B2C PropTech, AI-assisted real estate across Europe
- Movtoo (https://movtoo.com) — B2C on-demand urban delivery for individuals and businesses
- Hobconnect (https://hobconnect.com) — B2C social network around shared passions

**Custom build for third parties** (Asset Engineering service):
- Fixed price contract at discovery — no scope creep
- Custom code only — no no-code/low-code/WordPress
- 100% IP transfer to client
- Certification-ready: complete documentation from day one
- Timeline: 10-16 weeks
- Range: CHF 15,000-150,000+
- Pages: /services/build, /ce-que-nous-construisons (fr), /what-we-build (en), /was-wir-bauen (de), /lo-que-construimos (es), /cosa-costruiamo (it), /wat-we-bouwen (nl)

### 2. Advisory — Cybersecurity, AI, M&A Strategy

Three specialized advisory pillars across 23+ industries:

**Technology Advisory** (/advisory/technology)
- Cybersecurity: attack surface audit, penetration testing, incident response, cloud and on-premise hardening
- AI Audit & Trust: EU AI Act compliance, LLM red-teaming, algorithmic bias audit, decision traceability
- Tech Architecture: code audit, tech stack review, migration planning, security-by-design

**Strategy Advisory** (/advisory/strategy)
- Digital transformation roadmaps
- Data governance and GDPR/FADP compliance
- Innovation strategy and technology roadmaps
- Secure architecture design

**M&A Advisory** (/advisory/ma)
- Buy-side advisory: target identification, valuation, due diligence
- Sell-side advisory: preparation, positioning, buyer identification
- Deal structuring: asset deal vs share deal, earnout, SPV, escrow
- Post-merger integration

**Industries covered (23+):** Aerospace & Defense, Agriculture & Agritech, Automotive & Mobility, Banking & Financial Services, Chemistry & Materials Science, Construction & Infrastructure, Cybersecurity & Data Protection, E-commerce & Retail, Education & EdTech, Energy & Utilities, Fintech & Blockchain, Healthtech & Biotechnology, Hospitality & Tourism, Real Estate & PropTech, Manufacturing & Industry 4.0, Logistics & Supply Chain, Luxury & Consumer Goods, Media & Entertainment, Natural Resources & Mining, Healthcare & Medical Devices, Professional Services, Telecommunications, Transport & Logistics

### 3. AEGRYN Transact Platform

Europe's structured, session-based M&A platform for buying and selling digital tech assets.
Range: €100K-€50M. NDA-gated. Graded assets only. Not a broker — a platform with standardized process.

**Process:**
1. Seller submits asset → AEGRYN grades (AEG★ to B)
2. Asset listed with confidential dossier (CIM)
3. Buyer KYC → signs NDA → accesses full dossier
4. Session opens → competitive bids submitted
5. Closing → structured legal process with advisors

**Offer Models (Bid Models):**
- Club Deal — Lead bidder + up to 4 co-investors, single bid, min €100K
- Corporate — Legal entity (asset deal or share deal), min €250K
- Fund — PE, VC, Family Office, Search Fund, IC window 5-10 days, min €500K
- Equity Stake — Partial stake, no fixed minimum, SHA-based commitment

**Key Pages:**
- /transact — Platform overview
- /transact/catalog — Live catalog (NDA required for full dossier)
- /transact/sessions — Session calendar
- /transact/mandate — Submit sell mandate
- /transact/sell — Seller funnel: valuation + readiness score
- /transact/how-to-sell — Complete seller guide
- /transact/how-to-buy — Buyer onboarding guide
- /transact/how-it-works — Full 6-step process
- /transact/submit — Asset submission form
- /transact/buyers — Buyer pre-qualification (KYC + proof of funds)
- /transact/bid-models — Detailed offer structures
- /transact/results — Past transaction results

### 4. Talent — Executive Tech Recruitment

Placement of rare executive tech profiles across Europe. Confidential search. Pre-qualified candidates only. 48h response time for hiring mandates.

**Roles:** CTO, CISO, Head of AI / VP AI, VP Engineering, Head of Data, Head of Product, other C-level tech
**For candidates:** Submit profile → qualification interview → presentation to companies (confidential)
**For companies:** Submit mandate → 48h response → candidate search → pre-selected profiles → interviews
**All 23+ industries covered**
Page: /talent

## AEGRYN Grade System — CIFS Protocol

Proprietary grading methodology for digital assets. 5 grades, immutable, based on Code, Infrastructure, Finance, and Strategy scoring.

| Grade | DB Key | Color | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| AEG ★ | star | #5ADDA4 (mint) | Apex — absolute excellence |
| AAA | aaa | #C9A84C (gold) | Premium |
| AA | aa | #9BA8B0 (silver) | Solid |
| A | a | #4A90D9 (blue) | Standard |
| B | b | #D4820A (amber) | Early stage |

Only graded assets are eligible for AEGRYN Transact auction.
Pages: /grade, /grade/methodology, /grade/grading-system, /grade/submit, /grade/partners

Free, instant preliminary valuation of digital assets.
Criteria: ARR, NRR, churn, MRR, CAC, LTV, TAM, tech stack, team, IP, compliance.
Benchmarked against European comparable M&A transactions.

## Philosophy

- **Proprietary** — 100% ownership. No minority VC stakes.
- **Sovereign** — Swiss sovereignty. Our assets, our infrastructure, our data.
- **Durable** — Built for generations, not funding rounds.
- **Precision** — Every decision is documented, measured, traceable.
- **Transparency** — Towards partners, users and the market.
